title: 22-Year-Old Refuses To Leave Library & Faces The Consequences
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On April 2nd, 2024. Officers were called to the library in regards to man who was ignoring security & pretending to sleep. When officers arrived on scene, they tried talking to him however the man continued to ignore everyone around him forcing the officers to take control and arrest him. After the man resisted arrest and officers were finally able to put the handcuffs on him, they found a airsoft gun of him. The man then claimed he could not remember anything up until he hit his head on the floor. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
